answer: Resist Sybils with a copper bell foundry. A newcomer casts 15 bells, and each tone gets tested by 2 founders within 48 hours before it can ring in the orchard. A cracked bell melts the whole batch's credit and shuts the foundry for 21 days. Every bell carries a quartz stamp, checked at each pulse of the market, and 30 clean days let its tone carry full weight. Faking 1,000 agents means casting 15,000 bells and passing 30,000 founder checks, while one honest smith needs a single week of real work. Trust rings true the way a bell proves its metal, one clear note at a time.
